name: Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto

program.note: 16 months of academic study plus a 4-month paid internship (school wording).

class_size.note: Class profile not found as text on the pages read (admissions page refers to a class profile without a reachable link).

tuition_total.basis: School's 'Full-Time MBA academic fees (estimated)'; excludes university incidental and compulsory ancillary fees; fees set annually. Read as whole-program figure (page does not say 'per year'); international rate shown as value.

mandatory_fees_total.note: University incidental and compulsory ancillary fees not included in the academic fee and not quantified on the page (see Office of the Registrar). UHIP health insurance for international students: CAD $756 per year (counted in the living budget below).

living_budget_total.note: School: 'minimum funds a single student will need for living expenses for the first 12 months in Toronto', downtown residency. The remaining ~8 months of the 20-month program are not budgeted by the school.

scholarship.note: Rotman offers over $5 million in scholarships and awards to its students each year (all programs); Ontario Graduate Scholarship $5,000 per term for 2-3 terms. No average award or share of class published.

base_salary.note: Only figure published: CAD $134,000 total salary, 3-year average of Full-Time MBA classes 2022-24, including base, bonus and other compensation. Not a base salary, not a single cohort.

internship_monthly.note: inclusive of base, bonus and other compensation

employment.notes: The Employment and Salary Report is gated ('Request our Employment and Salary Report' form). The last public PDF is the 2021-22 report (apps.rotman.utoronto.ca/Admissions/MBAFT/Documents/Rotman%20Full%20Time%20MBA%20Employment%20and%20Salary%20Report%202021-22.pdf, 200); later years at the same path return 404. No industry/function/geography breakdown for a recent class available without the form.

profile.note: Class profile not readable on the pages fetched; third-party figures not reused.

rankings_cited.note: Academica Group news digest citing the FT, 2026-02-19

notes: To re-read: request the gated Employment and Salary Report (class of 2025) and find the class profile page.
